Its "The filing fee" section reads the petition's paragraph 3 correctly — a sworn statement that fees "mandated by A.C.A § 16-90-1419" have been paid — and correctly reports that no amount is printed on the form, which this lane confirmed by extracting the source PDF's text (paragraph 3 names the fee statute and no figure appears anywhere on the face). The repair is for a repairer with the legal record in front of them, not for this lane: state what the profile holds and reconcile it with the form's paragraph 3, which still recites the fee statute.
